description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No.01 of 2024 (Annual Excise License Fees)
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new regulatory fees for excise licenses under the Excise Ordinance. It contains a statutory instrument (Excise Notification No. 01/2024) that sets legal requirements and compliance standards for various liquor-related licenses, including specific fee structures and security deposits. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
